new_findings.root_cause: the 7 pinned tokenizer files + run artifacts are gitignored and ship in no commit, so verify_release.py preflight refuses to run until a quickstart generation step has been done; README's Release gate section (README.md:52+) does not say so, so a virgin clone hits PREFLIGHT FAIL with no pointer.

new_findings.root_cause: book/build_epub.py/pandoc emit a fresh urn:uuid in EPUB/content.opf (mirrored in toc.ncx) plus dcterms:modified = current UTC, and every zip entry carries the build time as mtime; build_epub.py sets no SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH (grep count 0) — yet the manifest pins the EPUB sha256 with no note, so a rebuild can never reproduce the pin.
new_findings.fix: document in manifest epub.note that the pin verifies the shipped artifact and a rebuild will differ (or pin a deterministic uuid/timestamp via SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH)
new_findings.parent_verification: content.opf urn:uuid f5ff5397-617f-4c81-8a75-463fa7cb8a9a; toc.ncx mirrors it; zip mtimes (2026,11,8,1,1,12); SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH count 0; manifest epub has NO note — CONFIRMED

new_findings.root_cause: src/audit/leakage.py classifier_leakage() returns None when SKLEARN is False (leakage.py:43), but scripts/audit.py:37 formats the result unconditionally with f'{acc:.3f}', raising TypeError; Appendix A documents `python scripts/audit.py`.
